svg.title: Call360 architecture
svg.desc: Six sources (call summaries, medical claims, Rx claims, prior authorization, grievances and surveys) feed Layer 1, BigQuery domain pipelines on Cloud Composer that keep full history. A factory DAG on Dataproc Serverless loads Layer 2, Bigtable, with a 90-day window keyed by memberId#eventDate. The Call360 API picks few-shot examples with an INT8 SBERT model, summarizes with Gemini, formats JSON with Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite with thinking off, and sends talking points to the agent desktop.
svg.text: Airflow on Cloud Composer · population → enrich → status buckets → global member ID
factory DAG · Dataproc Serverless PySpark · row key memberId#eventDate
